Offered source gems are split1 into persistent consumedItems; start sums gems into radius and creates spatial tracker. Concrete plains variant optionally consumes frostaya and derives snowy biome, persisting isSnowy. Runtime tick advances exact Manhattan iterator state, places grass/dirt on replaceable positions, mutates live-registry biome holders and marks chunk unsaved. After5 attempted placements sets persistent needsSource; next tile tick requires50 nearby source, aggregates real jar debits and restores them on shortage, then resumes. Own pair persists radius and full tracker; shared tile/context reconstruct by stable ritualID without replaying onStart.
